_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics (only 7% chance of ±2 score move) plus cancelled extremes favor drift into the adjacent Complacency band rather than a forced directional break.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls Complacency/HOLD; narrative is mildly constructive on industrials but silent on crypto phase ladder, so no hard conflict on HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, 30d momentum near flat, Fear & Greed 45-55, ETF flows subdued, score inside 47-54
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed under 40 with long unwind and negative momentum (back to deeper Anxiety) or spot ETF rebound with F&G above 60 and positive 30d impulse (up toward Disbelief)
